deviation: Java's `AccessibleObject` and `Member` map to `flint.engine.aot.descriptor.MemberDescriptorRef`. It identifies a member by declaring descriptor, kind and table index, and `.init` is an absent member. Its accessors return safe pointers to the generated method, constructor or property metadata. An API that asks for metadata the tables lack (JVM modifiers, backing-field details, a category the generator does not emit yet) throws `UnsupportedOperationException` until the generator adds it. framework-core owns the type, and every lane cites this deviation (coordinator, 2026-11-26).
reason: Flint has no runtime reflection; the published AOT tables replace it. Property entries may describe accessors and need not identify a backing field.
